title: Free Big Mac (MyMacca's App Required) @ McDonald's
body:
Deal: Free Big Mac (MyMacca's App Required) @ McDonald's

[card] Direct link: https://r23-qm4p9.maccas-deals.com/
[SmiTTy] Amazing thank you OP
In case anyone is wondering, in the app go to "more" then "got a voucher?" to enter your voucher code from the qr
[King Tightarse] I did that and it accepted it but I cant see the Big Mac anywhere.
I wonder where its hiding…
[Onemoredeal] It’s on the Home Screen for me under my deals
[superforever] Mine just copy and claim and auto added but my wife phone have to put the code in.
[Cheaplikethebird] Top tier post, a true OzBargain. Whoever reported this needs to hand in their OzB badge.
[PainToad] I reported it because the app was showing as expired. Seems to work now.
[Cheaplikethebird] Awwwwright I'll accept it you can keep your badge for now
[ironworthy] Any chance they will pull it early if too many people redeem?
[card] They have a cap of 5000 code redemptions, so unlikely
[AsukaST] Thanks OP!
The free big mac voucher in app expires 23:59 19/Aug Wed.
[team teri] First time in years I'll have Maccas. Can they entice me back? Will it be any better than the last disappointment?
Thanks OP for giving me a chance to find out risking just a sore tummy, but no financial cost ;-)
[JohnHowardsEyebrows] Yeah, they used to be cheap. Post-COVID they've been more expensive than local alternatives, but they had cheap deals on the app. Then they decided that $18 for a meal with an extra cheeseburger was a good deal. The idiots running McDonald's Australia should have been fired by head office long ago.
[justtoreply] Exactly. When Macca's is the same price as a burger elsewhere, it's a bad deal
[Gambo] this is going to be a popular post. gg OP
[Gambo] wow. that went quick! enjoy that big mac fast finger friends
[JohnHowardsEyebrows] So much better than the rubbish KFC $10 purchase 'free' Zinger that requires a Hawthorn supporter to kick 2 footies into a bucket.
[justtoreply] No way. I'd eat the KFC. The big Mac I wouldn't even touch for free
